text: Three studies. (1) Nascent phagosomes lack microbicidal and degradative activity; maturation requires orderly sequential fusion with specialized endocytic and secretory compartments, plus inward/outward vesiculation, tubulation and fission to recycle components and preserve size, culminating in phagolysosomes. (2) Capillary electrophoresis with electrochemical detection revealed catecholamines and metabolites in single lymphocytes and T- and B-cell clones; tyrosine hydroxylase inhibition lowered levels (lymphocyte synthesis), extracellular dopamine raised intracellular dopamine (uptake), and dopamine or L-DOPA dose-dependently inhibited lymphocyte proliferation and differentiation—evidence of an autocrine loop down-regulating lymphocyte activity. (3) In mouse small intestine after gamma-irradiation, FGF-2 mRNA and protein increased from 12 h, peaking 48–120 h; the ~24 kDa isoform predominated, localized to mesenchyme surrounding regenerating crypts. Exogenous rhFGF-2 enhanced crypt stem cell survival.
